name: Choir & Music Ministry
purpose: Ministering in psalms, hymns and spiritual songs — ushering the presence of God in excellence. Glory! Hallelujah!

name: Ushering & Hospitality
purpose: Receiving every soul with the love of Christ — order, joy and excellence, so all may hear the Word unhindered. You are most welcome!

name: Media & Technical
purpose: Conveying every meeting beyond these walls — sound, sight and livestream with spiritual precision and excellence for an ever-increasing audience.

name: Evangelism & Outreach
purpose: Taking the Gospel to every man’s world — winning, nurturing and perfecting souls with Rhapsody and the power of the Spirit.

name: Prayer & Intercession
